title: Knowledge snapshot command and standard components
description:
A generic Papyrus command that writes public-safe knowledge JSON, and standard front-end components that read it, built once in core so any publication with a knowledge base can use them (the pilot supplies theme tokens).

Snapshot: a papyrus knowledge snapshot command reads staff-side records, filters to public-safe (accepted nodes only; published items only; counts, ids, names, series and neighbour keys; never reference text or private notes), and writes JSON to the site data path (index, per-entity, clusters). Derived and rebuildable. Shares the scheduling mechanism with the live-numbers epic in PPY-77bb3b (scheduled job; needs explicit approval for new cloud resources).

Components (shared bundle): entity chip, sparkline, trend chart, graph neighbourhood, score readout; wire the existing recent-concepts, concept-list and concept-count Markus directives to the knowledge index so they stop rendering empty placeholders in static builds.

Parent initiative: PPY-428252. Related: PPY-64cb48 (live numbers for static sites, same snapshot mechanism); Biblicus blbs-d380cb.
